Sending money to your family in another country should be simple.

In practice, the traditional system charges high fees, takes days, and on some corridors simply doesn't operate.

With Mostro 🧌 and Lightning ⚡ sats arrive in seconds, to any wallet, in any country where there's an active node.

The recipient converts to their local currency with whoever they choose, in their own community, without depending on any centralized service.

Remittances shouldn't be a business for intermediaries. They should be a transfer between people.

https://mostro.network
